name: leeguooooo-plugins
description: Developer plugins by leeguooooo — for Claude Code.

plugins.name: curl-crypto-plugin
plugins.description: Decrypt encrypted curl request parameters and encrypt payloads for test-service calls.

plugins.name: wrangler-accounts
plugins.description: Cloudflare Wrangler multi-account helper. AWS-style profiles for Claude Code with a guard hook that blocks raw wrangler calls.

plugins.name: claude-statusbar
plugins.description: Lightweight Claude Code statusLine monitor. 3 styles × 9 themes, per-segment color management (each metric colors itself by its own severity), per-severity color overrides (cs config set color_ok|warn|hot), cache-expiry countdown + session-cost segments, conversational claude-statusbar skill (no slash commands needed) plus the legacy /statusbar slash commands, cs doctor self-diagnostic. v3.10.0 adds an opt-in live-activity line (in-progress todo, active tool, completed-tool rollup), git ahead/behind + session duration/lines on the project line, running-subagent lines, an opt-in bar_shimmer starfield on the battery bars, a self-hosted plugin marketplace, and a [worktree] marker when the checkout is a linked git worktree — plus a reliability fix so auto-update actually runs in daemon mode (detached, non-blocking) and the cache countdown is now per-session-correct. v3.9.0 makes the cache countdown auto-detect the real prompt-cache TTL (5m vs 1h) from the transcript's usage.cache_creation buckets, fixing a ~55-minute early `cache COLD` for Claude subscription (Pro/Max) users — Claude Code auto-requests the 1-hour TTL on a subscription (the deprecated cache_ttl_seconds config is no longer needed). v3.9.1 makes that countdown always show seconds (58m23s, 1h59m03s) so it visibly ticks instead of sitting on a static 58m. v3.8.1 fixes a long-standing daemon staleness bug: after `pip install -U`, the running daemon's pidfile kept lazy-spawn from restarting it, so users saw old renders until manual `cs daemon stop`; the thin client now detects the version drift via package mtime + a new `daemon_started_at` field and SIGTERMs the outdated daemon on the next tick. v3.8.0 adds a default-on second status-bar line `⤷ <project> ⎇ <branch>●` — project name from Claude Code's `workspace.repo.name` stdin field, branch read from `.git/HEAD` directly, dirty marker refreshed in the background with a 5s cache so the inline render never blocks on git (disable with `cs config set show_project_branch false`). v3.7.0 defends against statusLine hijacking via `cs --setup --project`. v3.6.0 makes daemon mode default — under 1% CPU continuously. Backed by the cs CLI on PyPI.

plugins.name: use-family
plugins.description: The whole *-use family in one install: every *-use plugin below as a dependency, a routing skill that tells the agent which one to use and how they combine, and a session-start check for missing CLIs, and CLIs kept at their plugin's version.

plugins.name: chrome-use
plugins.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents — drive a real, logged-in Chrome with snapshot/@ref structured reads, stealth, and multi-agent tab isolation. The skill teaches agents the CLI; an MCP server mode (chrome-use mcp) covers no-shell hosts.

plugins.name: cookie-use
plugins.description: Agent-friendly multi-account session manager — capture, store, list, switch, and apply logged-in sessions for any website, across browsers and profiles. Encrypted local vault, built on chrome-use.

plugins.name: iphone-use
plugins.description: Computer-use, but for the iPhone — agents see and drive a real phone over macOS iPhone Mirroring. Low-latency WebRTC video, near-native touch, HTTP API + MCP.

plugins.name: image-use
plugins.description: Use your ChatGPT subscription to generate images from the command line — no OPENAI_API_KEY, no gateway, no daemon. Zero-dep Python CLI + AI-agent skill.

plugins.name: mail-use
plugins.description: Email for AI agents — read, search, send and triage Gmail / QQ / 163 / any IMAP from the CLI or MCP. Part of the *-use family.

plugins.name: message-use
plugins.description: iMessage & SMS for AI agents through macOS Messages — read, search, watch and send texts, and pull verification codes (短信验证码) out of incoming messages with `message-use code --wait`. Read-only database access; sending previews until confirmed.

plugins.name: paste-use
plugins.description: Pastyx clipboard history for AI agents — list, search and read what you copied (text, links, code, images with recognised text, files), re-copy an old clip, or put text on the clipboard. Reads the app's local database read-only (no sign-in, works offline); secret-looking values are masked by default. macOS and Windows.

plugins.name: wechat-use
plugins.description: WeChat CLI and MCP for macOS Apple Silicon and experimental Windows x64. Windows includes a standalone runtime without system Python; macOS also supports HTTP Bridge and Wechaty.

plugins.name: profile-use
plugins.description: Safely fill registration, signup, checkout, banking, KYC, and onboarding forms from a private local personal profile — privacy-first, consent before submission.

plugins.name: memory-use
plugins.description: Portable long-term memory for AI coding agents — Markdown notes in a private git repo you own. Recall before work, write back after, background autosync, secret-scan hook, one-line new-computer setup.

plugins.name: ocs
plugins.description: open-cross-session — AI coding agents talking to each other: Claude Code, Codex and Pi sessions on this machine, and on paired machines on the same LAN over a mutually authenticated, encrypted link. Message, wake, delegate, get notified when a peer goes idle. One static binary, no server.

plugins.name: bitwarden-use
plugins.description: Bitwarden/Vaultwarden CLI with an ssh-agent-style background agent and FIDO2 passkey extraction — headless passkey logins, vault lookups, and a built-in SSH agent.

plugins.name: discord-use
plugins.description: Fast REST-only Discord CLI + MCP server in one ~6 MB Rust binary. Drop-in replacement for mcp-discord — no gateway, no Node.js, sub-second start.

plugins.name: chatgpt-use
plugins.description: Turn a ChatGPT web subscription into a coding-agent backend — no API key, no Codex billing. Ask/plan/review/delegate via the logged-in web conversation; built on chrome-use.
